jobs.title: Supply Chain Director
jobs.description:
DIRECTOR OF SUPPLY CHAIN

Location:
Markham, Ontario
Industry:
Electronics Manufacturing / Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS)
Reports To:
Chief Operating Officer (COO)

About the Opportunity

MERE HR & Consulting
is pleased to partner with an established and respected electronics manufacturing organization in Markham, Ontario, in the search for an accomplished Director of Supply Chain
.

Our client specializes in providing comprehensive electronic manufacturing and design services, supporting customers through printed circuit board (PCB) assembly, electronic component integration, product testing, prototyping, and low-to-mid-volume manufacturing. Operating in a technically demanding environment, the organization places significant emphasis on product quality, manufacturing efficiency, supply chain reliability, and customer satisfaction.

As the organization continues to strengthen its operational capabilities, it is seeking a highly experienced supply chain leader who can bring strategic direction, financial discipline, strong supplier relationships, and proven leadership to its supply chain operations.

This is an excellent opportunity for a results-oriented professional who understands the complexities of electronics manufacturing and is prepared to take ownership of supply chain performance at both the strategic and operational levels.

The Position

Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, the Director of Supply Chain will provide overall leadership and direction for the organization's supply chain function, encompassing strategic procurement, inventory management, material planning, supplier performance, and the movement of components and finished products throughout the manufacturing process.

The successful candidate will play an important role in balancing customer delivery commitments with inventory investment, procurement costs, supplier reliability, and operational efficiency.
Beyond managing day-to-day activities, this individual will be expected to evaluate existing systems and practices, identify opportunities for improvement, establish sustainable processes, and develop a high-performing supply chain team capable of supporting changing manufacturing demands.

The ideal candidate combines strategic business thinking with hands-on electronics manufacturing experience
, understands the challenges associated with global component sourcing, and can translate business priorities into measurable operational results.

Key Responsibilities

1. Supply Chain Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop, implement, and continuously refine an integrated supply chain strategy aligned with the organization's operational objectives, financial priorities, and customer service expectations.
Provide senior-level oversight of purchasing, material planning, inventory management, supplier relationships, and supply chain execution.
Take accountability for supply chain operating costs, inventory investment, supplier performance, and the organization's ability to meet customer delivery commitments.
Identify opportunities to reduce overall supply chain costs while maintaining product quality, continuity of supply, and customer satisfaction.
Partner with the COO and other members of senior management on operational planning, business improvement initiatives, and strategic projects.

2. Strategic Procurement & Global Supplier Management

Direct purchasing and sourcing activities for electronic components, printed circuit board assemblies, semiconductor products, electro-mechanical components, and other manufacturing materials.
Develop and maintain strong commercial relationships with domestic and international suppliers, contract manufacturers, and strategic business partners.
Lead supplier negotiations involving pricing, commercial terms, lead times, material availability, and service expectations.
Evaluate supplier capabilities, performance, cost structures, and associated operational risks.
Develop sourcing strategies to minimize exposure to global supply disruptions, extended procurement lead times, and supplier capacity constraints.
Work closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve material availability, quality, pricing, and delivery challenges.

3. Inventory Management, Material Planning & Supply Chain Performance

Oversee the planning and movement of materials throughout the supply chain, from initial purchasing and supplier delivery through manufacturing and final customer shipment.
Establish effective inventory management strategies that support production requirements while minimizing unnecessary working capital investment.
Monitor inventory levels, material consumption, replenishment requirements, and potential supply constraints.
Identify opportunities to reduce excess, slow-moving, or obsolete inventory without compromising production continuity.
Ensure effective coordination between purchasing, inventory planning, manufacturing requirements, and customer demand.

4. People Leadership, Development & Accountability

Provide leadership, coaching, and professional development to a team that includes Supply Chain Managers, purchasing professionals, buyers, and material planners.
Establish clear departmental objectives, responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability measures.
Monitor employee and departmental performance, identifying opportunities for improved productivity, effectiveness, and collaboration.
Support recruitment, workforce planning, cross-training, employee development, and succession planning within the department.
Promote a culture of teamwork, ownership, open communication, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Manufacturing Support

Work closely with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Production, Sales, and senior management to ensure supply chain priorities support business requirements.
Participate in New Product Introduction (NPI) activities, ensuring materials, sourcing strategies, and supplier capabilities are aligned with new manufacturing requirements.
Collaborate with Engineering and Production teams to address component availability, product changes, material substitutions, and manufacturing requirements.
Support the development of effective demand planning processes through coordination with internal departments.
Partner with Quality Assurance to address supplier performance concerns, material non-conformances, and corrective actions.
Facilitate effective communication between supply chain personnel and other business functions to resolve operational challenges.
Ensure customer requirements and delivery expectations are considered throughout procurement and manufacturing planning activities.

6. Process Improvement, Systems & Operational Excellence

Evaluate existing supply chain procedures, workflows, and systems to identify inefficiencies, operational gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement practices.
Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems to improve planning accuracy, inventory controls, and operational visibility.
Develop standardized processes and reporting practices to improve consistency, accountability, and decision-making.
Identify and eliminate process bottlenecks that affect purchasing efficiency, material flow, inventory management, or customer delivery.
Encourage data-driven decision-making supported by meaningful operational and financial performance measures.
Lead or participate in strategic improvement projects assigned by executive leadership.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Qualifications

10+ years of progressive supply chain experience
, including significant responsibility for procurement, inventory management, material planning, and supply chain operations.
Minimum 5 years of senior leadership experience within an electronics manufacturing environment
, with demonstrated responsibility for managing supply chain teams and operational performance.
Strong industry knowledge of electronic manufacturing processes, particularly printed circuit board assemblies (PCBA), semiconductors, electronic components, and electro-mechanical products.
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing supply chain strategies that improve operating efficiency, supplier performance, and inventory investment.
Strong understanding of global electronics supply chains, including sourcing challenges related to component shortages, extended lead times, single-source suppliers, and product obsolescence.
Proven ability to negotiate supplier agreements, manage vendor relationships, and implement cost-reduction strategies.
Advanced working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems and their application in procurement, inventory management, and manufacturing planning.
Practical understanding of lean manufacturing principles, process improvement methodologies, and operational performance management.
Experience leading, developing, and motivating multidisciplinary supply chain teams.
Strong analytical, financial, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills, with the confidence to collaborate effectively across departments and with senior leadership.
Ability to balance long-term strategic planning with the practical demands of a fast-moving manufacturing operation.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) activities within electronics manufacturing.
Demonstrated success improving inventory performance, reducing procurement costs, or strengthening supplier reliability.
Experience managing complex supplier networks and responding to electronic component shortages or end-of-life material challenges.
Background in manufacturing environments where product complexity, changing customer demand, and material availability require adaptable supply chain strategies.

The Ideal Candidate

We are particularly interested in connecting with an experienced supply chain leader who demonstrates the following qualities:

Strategic and Commercially Minded:
Understands how supply chain decisions influence profitability, working capital, operational performance, and customer relationships.

Technically Knowledgeable:
Brings meaningful exposure to electronic components and manufacturing environments, with a practical appreciation of procurement challenges unique to the electronics industry.

Collaborative Leadership Style:
Builds strong relationships across Engineering, Production, Quality, Sales, and executive leadership while fostering accountability within their own team.

Compensation & What This Opportunity Offers

Annual Base Salary: $90,000 – $100,000

This position presents an opportunity to assume a significant leadership role within an established electronics manufacturing organization.

Equal Opportunity Employer

MERE HR & Consulting and our client are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and respectful workplace.

We welcome applications from qualified individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. to build, lead, and mature an enterprise FinOps program focused on delivering measurable and sustainable cloud cost optimization
without compromising reliability, security, or engineering productivity.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role
requiring a strong combination of FinOps, cloud financial management, Azure cost optimization, financial analysis, forecasting, governance, and cross-functional leadership

.

Job Description

Why should you join our team?

Innergex Renewable Energy Inc. is an independent renewable energy producer with an extensive and growing portfolio of assets in Canada, the United States, France and Chile. The Corporation develops, acquires, owns and operates hydroelectric facilities, wind farms, solar farms and energy storage facilities.

For more than 30 years, Innergex has believed in a world where abundant renewable energy promotes healthier communities and creates shared prosperity. We are convinced that generating power from renewable sources will lead the way to a better world. We remain committed to responsible growth that balances people, our planet, and prosperity. We believe in offering an engaging, inclusive and supportive work environment where each team member can thrive.

Your contribution!

The Director of Financial Reporting provides strategic and operational leadership for the Financial Reporting function. The incumbent is responsible for the quality, integrity, completeness, and compliance of the consolidation, financial disclosure, and financial reporting processes under his or her responsibility, in accordance with applicable accounting standards, current regulatory requirements, and company policies. They remain ultimately responsible for the quality of these reports, including the proper application of IFRS, the consistency of financial disclosures, and the appropriateness of the accounting positions adopted prior to their approval by the Corporate Controller.

They also play a key role in talent development, succession planning, the ongoing improvement of processes, systems, and controls related to financial reporting, as well as in supporting strategic initiatives related to growth, restructuring, financing, and acquisitions.

Your day-to-day!

Provide strategic and operational leadership for the Financial Reporting function and ensure its continued development to meet the organization's current and future needs.
Be accountable for the quality, integrity, completeness, and compliance of the consolidated financial statements, the statutory financial statements under their responsibility, and the related financial disclosures, as well as for the appropriate application of accounting standards, the consistency of financial disclosures, and the appropriateness of the accounting judgments and positions adopted.
Ensure that financial information complies with IFRS, applicable regulatory requirements, financing agreements, company policies, and best practices in financial disclosure.
Serve as the internal authority on consolidation, financial reporting, and technical accounting for significant transactions, including acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, financing, strategic projects, and complex commercial agreements.
Make recommendations to senior management regarding accounting policies that have a significant impact on the organization's financial statements, financial performance, or disclosure requirements.
Ensure the governance of data, consolidation structures, and financial disclosure processes that support the organization's financial reporting.
Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors regarding financial statements, significant accounting policies, internal controls over financial reporting, and other matters within the scope of the position.
Support the organization's strategic initiatives, including acquisitions, divestitures, corporate restructurings, financing, growth projects, and organizational transformations that impact financial reporting.
Develop talent, ensure succession planning for the Financial Reporting function, and continuously strengthen the team's skills.
Promote continuous improvement, automation, and process standardization to enhance the quality, efficiency, agility, and resilience of the Financial Reporting function.

Your skills, our requirements!

At least 10 years of progressive experience in financial accounting, financial reporting, and consolidation.
Bachelor's degree in accounting.
Hold a professional accounting certification (CPA).
Proven experience in complex consolidation environments involving a large number of legal entities, multidimensional corporate structures, partnerships, non-controlling interests, complex joint venture or investment structures, and frequent corporate reorganizations.
Proven experience in cost accounting, including analyzing and documenting accounting positions related to complex transactions.
Significant experience in preparing, reviewing, and overseeing consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS. Experience with US GAAP is a plus.
A proven ability to design and refine processes that simultaneously improve operational efficiency, the quality of financial reporting, and the robustness of controls.
Experience in management and team development.
Experience with leading financial consolidation tools.
A recognized leader capable of mobilizing teams of professionals and exerting credible influence with internal and external stakeholders on complex issues related to financial reporting, financial disclosure, and technical accounting.
Strong professional judgment and a proven ability to analyze, challenge, and defend positions, conclusions, and recommendations related to complex issues of consolidation, financial reporting, and financial disclosure to external auditors, management, and other stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills (French and English; Spanish is a plus), including the ability to explain complex financial and accounting issues in layman’s terms to people at various levels within the organization.
Strong ability to fulfill a governance role, manage risks related to financial reporting, and strike a balance between rigor, operational performance, and business needs.
Strategic thinking that enables one to anticipate the financial, accounting, and organizational impacts of business decisions and transformation projects.
Recognized leadership in talent development, succession planning, employee engagement, and building high-performing teams.
Ability to operate effectively in an environment involving complex transactions, corporate restructurings, acquisitions, financings, or other events requiring a high level of expertise and judgment.
Extensive knowledge of Oracle Fusion or a comparable integrated ERP system.
Very good knowledge of a financial consolidation tool such as OneStream, HFM, or an equivalent tool.
Very good knowledge of a financial disclosure tool such as Workiva or an equivalent tool.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial analysis tools.
Ability to leverage automation, data analytics, and artificial intelligence tools to improve the efficiency, quality, and reliability of financial reporting processes.
Bilingualism (French and English, both spoken and written) is required to facilitate ongoing collaboration with various stakeholders outside Quebec.

Additional considerations!

The position is based at the Company’s headquarters in Longueuil, conveniently located steps from the Longueuil–Université-de-Sherbrooke metro station.
This position is a M3 level.

Our benefits!

Competitive salary and annual bonus;
Three weeks vacation to start and paid vacations during the holiday season;
100% Innergex-funded medical insurance from day one of employment, including primary care services through dialogue (or telemedicine) for permanent positions;
Group retirement plans with employer participation;
100% Employer-funded Wellness Account;
Electric vehicle (E-VIP) incentive program;
Hybrid work model;
Career development opportunities;
Offices accessible by public transportation.

Innergex is an equal opportunity employer that values each person’s unique background, diversity, experiences, perspectives and talents. Innergex is committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment and bases all employment decisions on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. The key to our success as a global company is to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

jobs.description:
About Univerus

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Burnaby, British Columbia, Univerus is a fast-growing enterprise software company specializing in vertical market solutions. With over 300 employees, more than 20 acquisitions, and a global customer base exceeding 3,500 organizations, Univerus delivers mission-critical technology across public and private sectors. Our flagship product, Unity ERP, powers operations in local government, utilities, construction, manufacturing, health and safety, education, and beyond.

Learn more at univerus.com.

About Bu

Since 1981, Baragar Systems has partnered with K–12 school districts across Canada and the United States to provide data-driven planning tools that transform complex enrolment, boundary, staffing, and demographic data into clear, confident decisions. Serving more than 100 school districts, Baragar has built a reputation for deep educational planning expertise and meaningful impact on how education leaders plan for the future. Our product suite includes Demographic Dynamics (enrolment forecasting), GeoSchool (boundary planning and analysis), ThemeMap (geographic data visualization), District Intelligence (data dashboards and reporting), Staff Allocator, School Locator and School Boundaries Online. All tools purpose-built for the unique planning challenges school districts face. Baragar has historically operated as a service-first organization. Each year, the team delivers custom geospatial and demographic data packages, assembled by experienced data analysts and GIS specialists, alongside an annual software deliverable. Deep client engagement, hands-on support, and tailored training are central to how Baragar works. This model has created strong, trust-based relationships, and that expertise remains a core part of who we are.

Baragar operates as a focused business unit within Univerus, combining the intimacy and expertise of a specialist team with the scale and investment of a growing global organization.

Learn more at baragar.com

Position Details

Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Salary Range: $120,000 to $145,000 CAD per year

Location: Surrey, BC, Canada - Hybrid

This is a replacement position.

Role Overview

Baragar is entering a new chapter, one that builds on decades of service excellence while developing stronger internal accountability for its technology and product direction. The domain expertise, client relationships, and delivery capability that define Baragar today are what we’re building from, and what we’re committed to protecting as we grow. We are now establishing clearer in-house leadership over product direction, a more deliberate approach to technology decision-making, and the capacity to develop internal technical capability alongside our existing development partnerships.

We are seeking a Director, Technology & Product to lead that work. This is a senior role spanning five core areas: leading change, technology leadership and modernization, product and delivery management, building internal capability, and budget and governance. The successful candidate will hold both the strategic and the operational; someone who understands legacy systems, manages vendor and delivery relationships with confidence, brings clear technology judgment, and has the presence and discipline to drive meaningful change in an organization with a long operational history. This is a role focused on forward momentum, building on what works while creating the conditions for meaningful change. It is not a purely strategic role; the person who succeeds here will be equally comfortable doing the work as directing it: writing requirements, staying close to delivery, and investing the time to deeply understand Baragar’s domain, its data, and how the organization operates before

driving change. They will have a direct hand in shaping what Baragar’s technology foundation looks like over the next several years. The expectation, and the commitment from the organization, is that this investment of time and understanding comes first.

Organizational Relationship

This role reports directly to the EVP of Baragar Systems and operates as the senior internal technology voice for the business unit. The Director, Technology & Product works closely with external development partners who currently deliver all of the product work, as well as with Baragar’s data analysts, GIS specialists, and client-facing staff. The role operates within Baragar’s structure as a focused business unit of Univerus but will engage with

Univerus technical leadership on strategic alignment and collaborate with counterparts in other business units.

Key Responsibilities

Leading Change

Act as the senior internal technology voice in leadership discussions, vendor discussions, and strategic planning, bringing clarity and confidence to complex technical decisions.
Hold the organization accountable to transformation milestones, engaging teams and leadership with clarity and credibility, while respecting the expertise and customer value already built into the business.
Communicate technology direction, progress, and change clearly across the broader organization ensuring parties at all levels understand the why, not just the what.

Technology Leadership & Modernization

Develop a deep understanding of Baragar’s existing products, development workflows, codebases, data structures, and hosting environments.
Lead the development and execution of a practical modernization roadmap for Baragar’s product suite, sequencing technology improvements in a way that reduces technical debt, ensures customer value is protected, and remains within approved budget parameters.
Evaluate options for cloud hosting, application architecture, database strategy, integrations, APIs, reporting, and security, and develop business cases to support recommendations.
Provide internal leadership of technical decision-making, building stronger in-house capability to complement existing development partnerships and ensure Baragar has clear internal direction on core product and architecture decisions.
Establish, evolve, or maintain development standards, release processes, documentation practices, code review expectations, QA processes, and security practices.

Product & Delivery Management

Stay actively involved in delivery at a working level, reviewing specifications, participating in development cycles, and maintaining enough technical depth to make informed decisions and spot problems early.
Lead the planning, resourcing, timelines, and delivery across multiple software products.
Oversee backlog management, release planning, and production support.
Manage and maintain strong working relationships with external development partners, ensuring delivery alignment, clear expectations, and mutual accountability for quality and timelines.
Partner with staff at all levels to translate organizational needs into clear technical priorities.
Translate between stakeholder requirements and technical constraints, turning business needs into clear development requirements and technical trade-offs into decisions leadership can act on.
Manage risks, budgets, and priorities to achieve the best possible outcome within approved parameters.

Building Internal Capability

Strengthen the documented, internally owned understanding of Baragar’s products and codebase, working collaboratively with existing partners and internal team members to build on what has already been captured, formalize what hasn’t, and ensure institutional knowledge continues to

transfer and grow over time.

Define the internal technical capabilities, roles, skills, and tooling, that Baragar needs to develop or acquire as the organization evolves, and build a practical plan for closing those gaps over time.
Identify the right opportunities to selectively build internal development capacity in areas where closer day-to-day ownership will best support Baragar’s next stage of growth, while maintaining effective and collaborative relationships with existing partners.

Budget & Governance

Manage the technology and delivery budget, including invoice review, tracking, and variance reporting.
Provide regular financial and delivery updates to senior leadership, highlighting risks, variances, and forecast implications.
Operate within approved budgetary and strategic parameters while making informed recommendations on delivery tradeoffs and priorities.

Education And Experience

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field is required.
An equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered. A graduate degree or MBA is an asset but not required.
A minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in technology leadership, with at least 3–5 years in a senior or director-level role at a software company. Experience in a smaller or mid-sized organization where you were close to the work, rather than directing large internal teams from a distance, is strongly preferred.
Experience within the educational planning field, particularly K–12, is considered an asset.

What We Offer

Health and Dental Coverage
RRSP/401K
EFAP
Generous Paid Time Off
Flexible Work Environment

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Payroll is a business-critical function, and organizations are looking for more efficient, technology-enabled ways to deliver it.

We’re looking for a senior payroll or employment tax professional who knows the market, sees where it’s going and wants to turn those insights into growth.

Shape and grow the business by identifying market opportunities and expanding our work with Canadian and multinational organizations.

You’re also excited by the opportunity to strengthen client relationships and help grow EY’s Payroll Operate business.

Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

jobs.title: Vice President Finance - Relocate to Sun Peaks!
jobs.description:
Vice President, Finance – Sun Peaks Resort

This is an on-site role and requires a physical presence at the designated location.

The Vice President, Finance is a strategic leadership role responsible for overseeing the financial health, planning, and operations of Sun Peaks Resort LLP and its affiliated entities. The VP, Finance will provide financial insight, recommendations, and hands-on support to enable high-growth initiatives while ensuring financial sustainability, compliance, and operational excellence.
Sun Peaks is Canada's second largest ski area and has been intentionally developed in accordance with our Master Plan (on our website, Province of BC). The Master Plan philosophy is to strategically evolve our recreational footprint through increased accommodation and enhancements to skier/guest services and infrastructure.

Sun Peaks Resort LLP is a wholly owned Canadian subsidiary of Nippon Cable Co. of Japan. As a private entity, our ownership group is committed to the long-term growth and success of Sun Peaks Resort.
This role requires a results and detail-oriented leader with strong financial acumen, strategic thinking, and an ability to drive financial performance in a dynamic and complex operational resort environment which includes a shared services model. This is a great opportunity for leaders who love to work with long-term strategy, a blend of technology/pragmatic solutions, and still know how and when to get involved in process to support and grow their organization and team.

The role is well suited to an experienced finance professional looking to build on their knowledge, or make a lifestyle change which better aligns with their career, personal and/or family goals.

With the above in mind, the following portfolios report to the VP Finance:
Finance & Payroll (shared services)
Information Technology (shared services)
Rental and Retail
Guest Services

Base Compensation:
$145,000 to $155,000

Physical Requirement:
Sedentary; work activities involve handling loads up to 5kg; predominantly in an indoor setting.

Primary Responsibilities:

1. Financial Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute financial strategies to support Sun Peaks Resort’s long-term growth and investment plans
Provide financial leadership to senior executives, department heads and other shared service teams to align financial goals with the company’s strategic objectives
Lead financial planning, forecasting, and budgeting processes to ensure alignment with business priorities through our May to April annual cycle
Strategic oversight of the payroll and benefits function, including labour reporting, workforce forecasts, compensation and more

2. Financial Operations & Reporting

Oversee financial reporting, ensuring accuracy, compliance with regulations, and timely delivery of financial statements
Manage and optimize financial systems, accounting processes, and internal controls to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk
Ensure compliance with all financial regulations, tax requirements, and reporting standards

3. Technology & Digital Strategy Leadership

Provide strategic oversight of the IT department, ensuring alignment with business and financial objectives
Oversee IT budgeting and financial planning, optimizing costs while maintaining technology efficiency and security
Ensure effective implementation of financial systems, enterprise software, and data management solutions
Support cybersecurity and risk management initiatives, ensuring data integrity and compliance with industry regulations
Collaborate with IT leadership to enhance digital transformation initiatives, including automation, reporting tools, and business intelligence capabilities

4. Investment & Growth Planning

Support capital investment decisions by conducting financial analysis and risk assessment
Evaluate funding and financing options for infrastructure development, expansion, and sustainability initiatives
Monitor financial performance metrics and provide recommendations to enhance revenue generation and cost management

5. Risk Management & Compliance

Implement and oversee risk management strategies, including financial, operational, and regulatory risks
Ensure adherence to ISO 14001 and other relevant environmental and financial certifications
Work closely with external auditors, financial institutions, and regulatory bodies to maintain compliance and financial transparency

6. Team Leadership & Development

Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team (including compensation & benefits) to build a high-performing financial department
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement within the finance function
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive operational efficiency and business performance

Skills you bring with you:

CPA designation required
MBA is considered an asset
Minimum of 7 years of progressive financial leadership experience
Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, accounting principles, and risk management
Experience in capital investment planning, financing structures, and business development
Proven ability to analyze financial data and provide strategic insights for decision-making
First-class communication skills with the ability to build and nurture relationships with partners and stakeholders
Demonstrated excellence in cross-functional collaboration
A champion for safety and guest experience; every member of the team adopts and promotes healthy and safe working practices and embodies a strong guest service ethic
Sensitivity to the realities of working in a resort environment with a strong community culture
Strong results orientation while respecting the values of integrity, teamwork, and balance

Why join us?

Sun Peaks is a Great Place To Work®! We are Canada’s second-largest ski area and a passionate team committed to providing the finest mountain resort experience to our guests.
Our people are at the heart of what we do, making a difference to our guests and our workplace every single day. That’s why we invest in the employee experience; to ensure everyone can be at their best and live our values.

No matter who you are, or your career journey to date, once you join the team at Sun Peaks, you’ll get to feel part of our special community right away. You and your wellbeing matter to us; you’ll have plenty of opportunities to grow and learn, as well as enjoy everything our beautiful mountain resort has to offer. In return, we expect you to be passionate about working together to create special memories for our guests, while taking care of our precious environment for others to enjoy into the future.

The perks and benefits you’ll get to enjoy:

Winter/Summer Season Lift, Trail and Golf passes
Initial entitlement to three weeks of paid vacation
Benefits plan and additional wellness components, including Health Spending Account and EFAP
Participation in our RRSP and matching DPSP programs
Company supported training and professional development opportunities
Dining discounts within our hotel & Resort-owned outlets
Retail discounts in our Resort-owned outlets
Friends and family rates at the Sun Peaks Grand Hotel
Reciprocal programs with partnering ski areas & hotels

We are an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture, and encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

We acknowledge that we live, work, and play on the traditional territory of the Secwépemc People.

jobs.title: Director, FP&A
jobs.description:
At Range Group
we believe in the power of the professional travel advisor. We represent over $4.5 billion in annual travel sales. All our investments stem from a common thesis, that travel advisors add real value to a trip. Travel advisors when equipped with technology and 24/7 support are irreplaceable. Equally important is our philanthropy. Range Foundation channels 10% of group profits to social impact. From exploration grants, improved access to education, new discoveries on sea and land, cultural infrastructure, and helping our global neighbors in times of need — we are investing to build a better future.

About The Role

This is a hands-on senior finance leadership role for someone who operates at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution. You’re as comfortable building a complex multi-entity model from scratch as you are presenting the story behind the numbers to the executive team.

As Director, FP&A, you will own the analytical engine that supports decision-making across Range Group’s portfolio of travel brands — leading enterprise planning and forecasting, managing a small team, and working directly with senior leadership to evaluate opportunities, navigate risks, and drive performance.

What You’ll Do

Financial Modelling & Planning

Build, maintain, and continuously improve financial models covering consolidated Group performance, brand-level P&Ls, cash flow forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Own the Group-level cash flow tracker and EBITDA bridging model, ensuring accuracy and timeliness week over week.
Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes across the organization.
Support ad hoc financial analysis — acquisition modelling, business case development, and covenant compliance.
Drive continuous improvement in financial planning frameworks, forecasting methodologies, and analytical tools.

Performance Management & Executive Insights

Own enterprise-wide performance reporting — financial reviews, KPI dashboards, executive scorecards, and variance commentary.
Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with senior leadership.
Translate financial results into clear, decision-ready insights that prompt action.
Identify and proactively flag emerging risks, opportunities, and performance trends across the portfolio.

Strategic Business Partnership

Partner with executive and business leaders to align financial plans with strategic priorities and growth objectives.
Evaluate investments, business initiatives, and strategic opportunities through modelling and scenario analysis.
Provide financial leadership on strategic initiatives, business cases, and investment decisions.
Support executive and Board reporting requirements.

Treasury & Foreign Exchange Management

Own foreign exchange exposure tracking, reporting, and scenario analysis across the Group's multi-currency operations.
Partner with treasury, banking partners, and external advisors to evaluate foreign exchange risks and mitigation strategies.
Assess the financial impact of currency fluctuations on forecasts, budgets, cash flow, and business performance.
Develop recommendations and decision-support materials for leadership regarding FX risk management and capital planning.
Monitor market trends and currency movements, proactively identifying risks and opportunities that may impact business performance.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

Lead a small finance team — including a Finance Manager and intern — as a player-coach: owning models and analysis end-to-end while delegating and developing where appropriate.
Foster a high-performance, analytically rigorous culture within the team.
Support ERP and reporting tool improvements from a finance data and output perspective.
Champion the evolution of finance from a reporting function to a true strategic business partner.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Strategic Finance, or Finance Business Partnering — with a track record of owning complex models in a multi-entity environment.
Advanced Excel skills — non-negotiable. You build models from scratch, structure them for auditability, and are fast and precise in the tool.
Strong accounting foundation: you understand how the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement connect inside a model.
Proven experience leading enterprise budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes.
Experience analyzing foreign exchange exposure, multi-currency financial impacts, and scenario modelling within a corporate FP&A, finance, or strategic finance environment.
Strong executive presence, comfortable presenting to senior leadership and capable of influencing and constructively challenging stakeholders.
Experience in multi-entity and multi-currency operating environments.
CPA designation strongly preferred; candidates without the designation will be considered where technical skills and experience are strong.
Background in travel, technology, hospitality, or another fast-paced, multi-brand environment is an asset.

Who You Are

You are a builder. You prefer to own models end-to-end and take pride in work that is structured, auditable, and built to last.
You are intellectually curious and detail-oriented, but able to zoom out and connect the numbers to a broader business narrative.
You operate well with ambiguity and can manage competing priorities without losing accuracy or composure.
You are a collaborative leader who still wants to be close to the work — energized by doing, not just directing.
You communicate with a low-ego, peer-level style — credible with senior stakeholders, collegial with the broader team, and proactive about surfacing issues.

Why Join Range Group

This is a rare opportunity to bridge corporate finance and executive strategy in a multi-brand travel and technology portfolio. You’ll have genuine influence — shaping how capital is allocated, how performance is communicated, and how the finance function evolves as the company grows.

The role carries real complexity: multi-entity consolidations, multi-currency exposure, and a direct reporting line to the Chief Finance Officer. You’ll lead a small team and have the space to build the frameworks and processes that become the foundation for the company’s next phase.

Hybrid Work Model

We’re based in Toronto and targeting three days in office per week, with flexibility built in.

We provide a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. Employees have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and compensation tied to business and individual performance. The actual compensation may vary depending on local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training.

We are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If you require accommodation due to a disability at any stage of our hiring process, please advise us when completing your application.

The Range Group may use artificial intelligence throughout the recruitment process to screen, assess or select applicants for this position. These tools assist our hiring team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.

We thank all candidates for their interest however only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Ecommerce Director - Royal Canin (Canada)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The E-Commerce Director
for Royal Canin Canada
is a member of the PSLT leadership team and is responsible for leading the One Demand E-comm organization and shaping the digital growth agenda across Pureplay partners. This role oversees end‑to‑end business ownership for Amazon and Chewy, drives portfolio decision making, leads retail media effectiveness, and ensures a Perfect Digital Store experience across platforms for pureplay and omni customers.

The Director will partner cross‑functionally to accelerate profitable growth, strengthen brand equity online, and unlock new demand opportunities in service of the ambition to win and grow share in the dynamic and fast-evolving online specialty pet care landscape.

What are we looking for?

Undergraduate degree required, preferably a BA/BS in Marketing or Business Administration. MBA or other graduate degree is an asset.
10+ years of experience in E‑Commerce, Digital Marketing, Category Management, Sales, or related commercial roles.
People management experience (2+ years).
Proven track record managing Amazon, Chewy, or other Pureplay businesses.
Strong analytical and financial acumen with experience managing customer P&L performance including forecasting, trade planning, and margin management.
Experience leading & developing high‑performing teams and working in a matrixed environment.
Knowledge of retail media platforms (Amazon Ads, Chewy Media) and digital marketing & retail media fundamentals.
Bilingual (English/French) an asset.

What will be your key responsibilities?

E-Commerce Leadership, Growth Strategy & Portfolio

Lead the One Demand E-Commerce team with clear strategic direction, capability building, and talent development.
Own the full P&L performance for Amazon & Chewy including forecasting, planning, and growth delivery.
Develop and execute customer‑specific omni business plans aligned with overall Royal Canin brand and category strategies.

Growth Strategy & Portfolio Development

Define the Pureplay‑led growth agenda, identifying whitespace, emerging trends, and category opportunities.
Drive portfolio strategy and distribution for channel, ensuring offerings meet digital shopper needs and platform economics.
Partner with Marketing, R&D, Supply, and Finance to bring new innovation and channel‑specific solutions to life where possible.

Retail Media Strategy & Execution

Lead the retail media strategy across Amazon, Chewy, and other platforms to maximize ROI and accelerate traffic & conversion.
Oversee the planning, activation, and optimization of retail media investments, leveraging data‑driven insights and full‑funnel measurement.
Collaborate with media agency & Amazon Ads teams to ensure cohesive digital activation aligned to portfolio strategy.

Perfect Digital Store Excellence

Own the Perfect Digital Store framework and deployment across online partners, ensuring excellence in content, search, ratings & reviews, availability.
Continuously analyze platform performance and shopper behavior to create actionable insights and optimization plans.
Leverage digital tools & AI capability to drive the Perfect Digital Store agenda and enhance content effectiveness.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership

Serve as the strategic connector between Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance.
Serve as a member of the PSRO leadership team.
Influence senior stakeholders on investment needs, priorities, and strategic choices rooted in data and customer insights.
Champion a digital‑first mindset and elevate e‑commerce acumen across the broader organization.

Talent Agenda

Build the functional capability and the engagement among PSRO team.
Participate In MARS ONE talent conversation (FSLT member)
Establish functional and leadership curriculum for each member of the team.
Responsible for the planning and execution of the Ecomm function training capabilities curriculum.

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.

jobs.title: Director, International Business Transformation & Strategy Execution (flexible location)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

The work model for the role is:
Hybrid

Your Role And Responsibilities

This Director role is a strategic transformation position within ABB's NEMA International division, reporting to the EVP International Sales. The role is pivotal in building a scalable international business platform by strengthening alignment across Regions, Business Lines and functions, removing structural barriers to growth and driving implementation of the Stabilize-Optimize-Scale roadmap. The successful candidate will drive business transformation across regions while building scalable operating foundations, combining expertise in strategy execution, operating-model redesign, business process management, change leadership, and executive influence within a complex global matrix.

The work model for the role is: hybrid ;

The role is contributing to the Motion NEMA Motors division globally.

International travel of approximately 30-40% will be required for the role.

You will be mainly accountable for:

Own and drive the NEMA International transformation roadmap aligned with the Stabilize-Optimize-Scale journey, translating strategy into prioritized initiatives with clear outcomes, milestones and success measures while maintaining visibility of progress and risks to leadership.
Act as senior integrator between NEMA International and Global Business Lines, establishing governance mechanisms and cross-functional commitments that align product, portfolio, and investment priorities with international market requirements while escalating critical dependencies that constrain growth.
Lead resolution of systemic barriers at the interfaces between International Sales, Global Operations, IT, Finance, HR and other supporting functions, converting fragmented issues into prioritized root-cause initiatives with clear accountability and measurable outcomes.
Serve as custodian of the NEMA International target operating model, ensuring organizational accountabilities, governance, processes, technology and capabilities evolve coherently to enable profitable international growth, from stabilization through optimization and scale, while designing the organization for future growth and acquisitions.
Lead an executive-level International Transformation Office that manages the transformation portfolio, governance cadence, dependency view and risk escalation, mobilizing cross-functional workstreams and intervening to resolve ownership gaps, resource constraints or delayed decisions.
Lead adoption of the new international organization and ways of working through change leadership, stakeholder engagement and capability building, while establishing a continuous improvement framework that connects frontline issues to structural business improvements and embeds continuous improvement into leadership accountability.

Qualifications for the role:

Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in business transformation, strategy execution, operating-model design, commercial excellence, enterprise program leadership or management consulting.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Strategy, Operations, Information Systems or a related discipline.
Experience in an internal strategy, transformation, business excellence or consulting role.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation across multiple geographies or business units.
Proven ability to align senior stakeholders and functions behind a shared agenda without relying on direct authority.
Experience translating strategy into executable roadmaps, governance, operating mechanisms and measurable outcomes.
Strong business acumen and ability to connect transformation to customer value, growth, margin, cash, productivity and organizational capability.
Excellent executive communication, facilitation and synthesis skills.
Ability to constructively challenge established practices and navigate ambiguity with pace and judgement.
Familiarity with international commercial models, CRM/ERP environments and end-to-end customer processes.
Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, electromechanical or B2B technology environment is an advantage. Recognized transformation, change management, Lean, Six Sigma or program-management certification is a plus.
Fluent English language skills.

More about us:

ABB’s NEMA Motors Division is a marketer, designer and manufacturer that offers Baldor-Reliance® industrial electric motors, primarily in North America. The Division focuses on quality, reliability and efficiency to provide a comprehensive offering of NEMA motors in the market across most industrial segments and applications.

We value people from different backgrounds. Apply today for your next career step within ABB and visit www.abb.com to learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website
www.abb.com
.

_________________

Directeur(-trice) transformation des activités internationales et exécution de la stratégie (lieu de travail flexible)

Nos convictions

Chez ABB, nous nous engageons à relever les défis mondiaux. Nos valeurs fondamentales — la bienveillance, le courage, la curiosité et la collaboration —combinées à notre engagement envers la diversité, l’inclusion et l’égalité des chances, sont au cœur de notre volonté de donner à chacun et chacune les moyens de créer des solutions durables.

Écrivez le prochain chapitre de votre histoire chez ABB.

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Ce poste de direction est axé sur la transformation stratégique au sein de la division NEMA International d’ABB et relève du vice-président exécutif, ventes internationales. Il joue un rôle essentiel dans la mise en place d’une plateforme d’affaires internationales évolutive en renforçant l’alignement entre les régions, les secteurs d’activité et les fonctions, en éliminant les obstacles structurels à la croissance et en pilotant la mise en œuvre de la feuille de route Stabiliser-Optimiser-Déployer à grande échelle. La personne retenue pilotera la transformation des activités dans les différentes régions tout en établissant des fondations opérationnelles évolutives, en mettant à profit son expertise en exécution de la stratégie, en refonte des modèles opérationnels, en gestion des processus d’affaires, en leadership du changement et en influence auprès de la haute direction dans une structure matricielle mondiale complexe.

Le mode de travail pour ce poste est : hybride;

Ce poste contribue aux activités de la division Moteurs NEMA du secteur Motion à l’échelle mondiale.

Ce poste exige des déplacements internationaux représentant environ 30 à 40 % du temps de travail.

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

Prendre en charge et piloter la feuille de route de transformation de NEMA International, en cohérence avec le parcours Stabiliser-Optimiser-Déployer à grande échelle, en traduisant la stratégie en initiatives prioritaires assorties de résultats, de jalons et de critères de réussite clairs, tout en assurant à la direction une visibilité sur les progrès et les risques.
Agir comme principal point d’intégration entre NEMA International et les secteurs d’activité mondiaux, en établissant des mécanismes de gouvernance et des engagements interfonctionnels qui alignent les priorités en matière de produits, de portefeuille et d’investissements sur les exigences des marchés internationaux, tout en portant à l’attention de la direction les interdépendances critiques qui freinent la croissance.
Piloter la résolution des obstacles systémiques aux interfaces entre les ventes internationales, les opérations mondiales, les TI, les finances, les RH et les autres fonctions de soutien, en regroupant les problèmes isolés en initiatives prioritaires visant leurs causes fondamentales, assorties de responsabilités claires et de résultats mesurables.
Veiller au maintien du modèle opérationnel cible de NEMA International, en s’assurant que les responsabilités organisationnelles, la gouvernance, les processus, les technologies et les capacités évoluent de façon cohérente pour soutenir une croissance internationale rentable, de la stabilisation à l’optimisation, puis au déploiement à grande échelle, tout en concevant l’organisation en fonction de sa croissance et de ses acquisitions futures.
Diriger un bureau de transformation internationale au niveau de la haute direction, responsable du portefeuille de transformation, du rythme de gouvernance, du suivi des interdépendances et du signalement des risques, en mobilisant les chantiers interfonctionnels et en intervenant pour résoudre les lacunes dans l’attribution des responsabilités, les contraintes de ressources ou les retards décisionnels.
Piloter l’adoption de la nouvelle organisation internationale et des nouvelles façons de travailler grâce au leadership du changement, à la mobilisation des parties prenantes et au développement des capacités, tout en établissant un cadre d’amélioration continue qui relie les problèmes de première ligne aux améliorations structurelles des activités et intègre l’amélioration continue aux responsabilités de la direction.

Qualifications Requises Pour Le Poste

Au moins 10 ans d’expérience avec des responsabilités croissantes en transformation des activités, en exécution de la stratégie, en conception de modèles opérationnels, en excellence commerciale, en direction de programmes d’entreprise ou en conseil en gestion.
Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en administration des affaires, en génie, en stratégie, en gestion des opérations, en systèmes d’information ou dans une discipline connexe.
Expérience dans un rôle interne en stratégie, en transformation, en excellence opérationnelle ou en consultation.
Expérience démontrée dans la direction de transformations complexes et interfonctionnelles touchant plusieurs régions géographiques ou unités d’affaires.
Capacité éprouvée à rallier les parties prenantes de la haute direction et les fonctions autour de priorités communes, sans s’appuyer sur une autorité hiérarchique directe.
Expérience dans la traduction de la stratégie en feuilles de route réalisables, en structures de gouvernance, en mécanismes opérationnels et en résultats mesurables.
Solide sens des affaires et capacité à relier la transformation à la valeur pour la clientèle, à la croissance, aux marges, aux flux de trésorerie, à la productivité et aux capacités organisationnelles.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication auprès de la haute direction, en animation et en synthèse.
Capacité à remettre en question les pratiques établies de façon constructive et à évoluer dans l’ambiguïté avec rapidité et discernement.
Connaissance des modèles commerciaux internationaux, des environnements de gestion de la relation client (CRM) et de planification des ressources de l’entreprise (ERP), ainsi que des processus clients de bout en bout.
Une expérience dans un environnement industriel, manufacturier, électromécanique ou de technologies interentreprises (B2B) constitue un atout. Une certification reconnue en transformation, en gestion du changement, en Lean, en Six Sigma ou en gestion de programmes constitue un atout.
Maîtrise de l’anglais.

Pour en savoir plus sur nous

La division Moteurs NEMA d’ABB commercialise, conçoit et fabrique des moteurs électriques industriels Baldor-Reliance®, principalement en Amérique du Nord. La division mise sur la qualité, la fiabilité et l’efficacité afin d’offrir une gamme complète de moteurs NEMA sur le marché, couvrant la plupart des segments et des applications industriels.

Nous valorisons les personnes de tous horizons. Postulez dès aujourd’hui po

jobs.description:
Job Title: Vice President, M&A Integration and Clinic Onboarding

Department: Operations

Scope: National – Canada

Reports to: Chief Growth Officer

Location: Toronto, Ontario (4 Days in Office, 1 Day Remote)

About 123Dentist

At 123Dentist, we are one of Canada’s largest and fastest-growing dental support organizations, supporting more than 500 clinics and 10,000 team members across the country. Growth through acquisition is central to that story, and our M&A Integration and Clinic Onboarding team makes sure every practice that joins the network is set up for success from day one.

Position Overview

123Dentist is seeking an accomplished executive to lead its national M&A Integration and Clinic Onboarding function. This leader will be responsible for bringing together the existing teams into a unified, scalable operation that ensures newly acquired dental practices transition successfully into the 123Dentist network, maintain operational continuity and deliver against acquisition objectives.

Reporting to our Chief Growth Officer, the Vice President M&A Integration and Clinic Onboarding will oversee the full integration lifecycle, from pre-close planning through operational stabilization and transition to Regional Operations. The role will also drive post-acquisition value creation in partnership with Finance and Operations, while ensuring a positive integration experience for partner dentists, clinic leaders and employees. Success will require strong commercial judgment, operational execution and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a highly acquisitive, multi-site environment.

Key Accountabilities

Integration Strategy & Executive Leadership

Lead the national M&A Integration and Onboarding function, with accountability for its strategy, operating model, resources, priorities and overall performance.
Establish scalable integration processes, governance frameworks and standards that support multiple concurrent acquisitions across the network.
Exercise delegated decision-making authority over integration priorities, approved budgets and resources, ensuring alignment with organizational growth objectives.
Provide executive leadership with visibility into integration performance, material risks, resource requirements and strategic opportunities.

Acquisition Integration & Operational Readiness

Oversee the end-to-end operational integration of acquired practices, from permitted pre-close planning through Day 1 readiness, stabilization and formal operational handoff.
Establish acquisition-specific integration plans, milestones, accountabilities and risk mitigation strategies based on the complexity and needs of each practice.
Ensure effective coordination across clinic operations, HR, Finance, IT, Marketing, Procurement and other functions to maintain operational and patient care continuity.
Identify and resolve integration challenges, ensuring acquired clinics transition efficiently into the 123Dentist network.

Post-Acquisition Value Creation & Financial Performance

Lead the development and execution of post-acquisition value creation plans aligned with each acquisition’s investment case and the organization’s growth strategy.
Partner with Finance, Regional Operations and functional leaders to establish measurable revenue, growth, productivity and cost-efficiency initiatives.
Monitor integration-related financial and operational performance, identify variances and drive corrective actions with accountable business leaders.
Ensure financial value realization is appropriately tracked and validated by Finance, with ongoing performance accountability clearly transitioned to Regional Operations.

People, Culture & Partner Experience

Establish a consistent, relationship-focused onboarding experience for acquired practice owners, partner dentists, clinic leaders and employees.
Partner with HR and Regional Operations to identify and address critical talent retention risks, leadership transitions and workforce integration requirements.
Lead integration-related change management and communication efforts, promoting engagement, cultural alignment and trust throughout the transition.
Preserve strong local practice relationships while supporting the adoption of 123Dentist’s operating standards and organizational values.

Integration Governance & Operational Handoff

Establish cross-functional integration governance, including clear decision rights, accountabilities, milestones, escalation protocols and performance expectations.
Lead alignment among Corporate Development, Operations, Finance, HR, IT, Legal and other functions to ensure effective integration execution.
Establish formal integration completion and handoff criteria, ensuring operational readiness and clear ownership of outstanding risks and initiatives.
Partner with Regional Operations to ensure a seamless transition of accountability and sustainable clinic performance following integration.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead the consolidation of the existing M&A Integration and Clinic Onboarding teams into a unified national function.
Establish an effective organizational structure, clear leadership accountabilities and resource plans aligned with the acquisition strategy.
Build, coach and develop high-performing teams capable of managing multiple integrations and delivering measurable results.
Drive continuous improvement through standardized processes, performance reporting and scalable integration capabilities.

Qualifications & Experience

Significant progressive leadership experience in M&A integration, multi-site operations or operational transformation, ideally including 12–15 years of relevant experience.
Proven experience leading multiple acquisitions and integrating businesses within complex, geographically distributed organizations.
Demonstrated ability to build and lead integration teams, establish governance and deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.
Strong financial and commercial acumen, including investment-case execution, performance measurement and value realization.
Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior executives, operational leaders and key stakeholders.
Strong relationship management and change leadership capabilities, particularly when integrating acquired businesses and retaining critical talent.
Proven ability to balance strategic priorities with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, decentralized environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Finance or a related field; MBA or equivalent advanced qualification considered an asset.

Preferred Experience

Experience in highly acquisitive, multi-location organizations, including dental support organizations, veterinary networks, pharmacy, optometry, healthcare services or other decentralized service businesses. Experience in private equity-backed or high-growth acquisition environments is highly desirable.

What Sets You Apart

You thrive in a highly acquisitive, fast-paced, decentralized environment, balancing strategy with hands-on execution. You bring sound commercial judgment, lead cross-functional teams, influence senior executives, and build trust with partner dentists, clinic leaders and employees as practices join the network.

Why Join 123Dentist?

Lead a national function with real ownership, including delegated decision-making authority over integration priorities, budgets and resources
Build something new by bringing the existing M&A Integration and Clinic Onboarding teams together into one unified, scalable operation
Play a central role in the growth of one of Canada’s largest and fastest-growing dental support organizations
Partner with executive leadership, Finance and Regional Operations to turn each acquisition’s investment case into measurable results
Shape the experience of partner dentists, clinic leaders and employees as new practices join the network
