new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Clinical Trials Performance & Head of Operations, SPHERE CRO
new_jobs.description:
CONTACT INFORMATION

If you are interested in being considered for this exciting and impactful opportunity,

please submit your cover letter and current resume by email to Chris Sawyer, Senior Consultant, at chris.sawyer@lhhknightsbridge.com .

THE ORGANIZATION

Unity Health Toronto is one of Canada’s largest Catholic healthcare networks serving patients, residents and clients across the full spectrum of care, spanning primary care, secondary community care, tertiary and quaternary care services to post-acute through rehabilitation, palliative care and long-term care, while investing in world-class research and education.

Research is a cornerstone of Unity Health Toronto’s mission, bringing together world-class scientists, clinician-researchers, trainees, and research staff to advance discoveries that improve patient care and strengthen health systems. With internationally recognized strengths across clinical, scientific, and population health research, Unity Health is committed to translating innovative research into meaningful impact for patients, communities, and the broader healthcare system.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Clinical trials are a key part of Unity Health Toronto's Exceptional Care Without Exception strategic plan, advancing research excellence across the network while providing patients with access to innovative therapeutics that may not otherwise be available. SPHERE CRO , one of Canada's leading academically-affiliated Contract Research Organizations (CRO), complements this work by delivering end-to-end clinical research services to academic, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and industry partners, including site management, project management, data management and technologies, regulatory affairs, biostatistics, and patient engagement.

A newly-created role reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, Research, and overseeing a team of approximately 50 people, the Senior Director will lead the execution of Unity’s clinical trials strategy, including the build of the Central Clinical Trials Unit, the adoption of key technologies such as the enterprise deployment of the clinical trials management system, and initiatives that position Unity’s sites as a global leader in clinical trials performance. The Senior Director will also lead the Industry Preferred Partnership Model, further fostering relationships with existing global pharmaceutical partners while pursuing new partnerships aligned with Unity’s clinical trials strategy. In addition, the role will oversee the financial and operational performance of SPHERE CRO, with full accountability for business development, client relationships, strategy, operations, and Profit and Loss (P&L) oversight.

Qualifications And Experience

10+ years of senior leadership experience in strategy and operations with a pharmaceutical portfolio including focus on research and development, biotechnology, or contract research organization (CRO).
MBA, Master of Science, or equivalent degree in a related field.
Demonstrated success building or transforming a clinical trials enterprise in partnership with global industry partners.
Experienced in successfully negotiating master agreements with global or large industry clients.
Demonstrated success operating a CRO or similar life sciences organization with regional or global studies to meet the needs of academic, industry and non-government organizational clients.
Demonstrated ability in leading business development or sales function of life sciences organizations, particularly related to a CRO.
Deep knowledge of ICH-GCP, Health Canada, FDA, EMA and applicable regulatory frameworks.
Experienced in managing large portfolio budgets including forecasting resourcing demands, pricing and profitability analysis, and variance analysis.
Superior interpersonal, influencing, and stakeholder relationship skills to foster alignment, goal congruence, and enthusiasm across clinical, institutional, and industry stakeholders.

CONTACT INFORMATION

If you are interested in being considered for this exciting and impactful opportunity,

please submit your cover letter and current resume by email to Chris Sawyer, Senior Consultant, at chris.sawyer@lhhknightsbridge.com .

new_jobs.title: Director of Product Development
new_jobs.description:
Location: Winnipeg, Manitoba | On-site

About EQ3

EQ3 is a Canadian furniture company headquartered in Winnipeg, creating timeless furniture that brings together thoughtful design, quality materials and enduring value. Our business connects Canadian upholstery manufacturing, retail showrooms, e-commerce, and wholesale, giving our product development team a direct role in shaping our collections and the customer experience.

The opportunity

We are looking for a Director of Product Development to lead product strategy and development across the EQ3 portfolio. Reporting to the President, you will guide products from initial concept through development, launch and lifecycle management.

You will combine design judgment with commercial insight to build a cohesive assortment that delivers quality, comfort and value. Working closely with engineering, manufacturing, procurement, marketing, sales and operations, you will turn customer needs and business priorities into a clear product roadmap that supports profitable growth.

This position is based on-site in Winnipeg, Manitoba.

What You'll Do

Lead product strategy, planning and lifecycle management across the EQ3 portfolio.
Develop and manage the product roadmap, setting priorities, milestones and deliverables for new products and improvements to existing collections.
Translate customer feedback, market research and business insights into clear development briefs and business cases.
Guide decisions on materials, construction and product features, balancing design, quality, comfort, durability, cost and manufacturing feasibility.
Collaborate across departments to coordinate product launches and meet financial and customer satisfaction goals.
Evaluate assortment performance and identify opportunities to strengthen collections, improve margins, reduce unnecessary complexity and improve product availability.
Engage with customers and channel partners to understand product performance and emerging needs.
Present product direction, progress, business cases and risks to the President and other stakeholders.
Lead and develop the product development team, establishing clear expectations and strong working relationships across the business.

What You'll Bring

A master's degree in product leadership, business administration, marketing, finance, economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
A proven record of developing and launching successful products, managing product lines and building cohesive product portfolios.
Strong commercial judgment and the ability to translate customer research, market insights and performance data into practical decisions.
Demonstrated leadership skills and the ability to influence and align teams across functions.
Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience in furniture, home furnishings or related consumer products is an asset, particularly in environments that connect design, materials and manufacturing.

Working at EQ3

Join a collaborative team where thoughtful design and practical problem-solving shape the work. You will have the opportunity to influence our product portfolio and work closely with colleagues across manufacturing and our customer-facing channels.

We Offer

A comprehensive benefits package and support for work-life balance.
Employee discounts, wellness programs and group banking benefits.
Community involvement, employee recognition and activities through the EQ3 Spirit Committee.
Opportunities for professional growth and internal advancement.

How To Apply

Submit your résumé and cover letter using the Apply

button on this posting.

Open: Until November 24, 2026.

We thank all applicants for their interest. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
